7947039146046.title: Anjuman Stole - Red
7947039146046.description:
"Hai Jazba, Junoon Tu Himmat Na Haar.."

Sometimes, the thought of leaving your homeland arises, especially during the tough days. And it's understandable: You and I are both scared of what the future holds. But despite all the uncertainties, it’s still our pehchaan, regardless of who we are and where we come from. It’s still the place that unites You and I.   

Jazba Weaved Stole is a reminder that there are still many challenges awaiting us, but we must keep our heads held high. Let the jazba within you keep burning, as we overcome these difficulties together. 
Poetry
Pakistan = پاکستان

Pak Watan = پاک وطن
Dil - Jaan = دل جان
Pehchaan = پہچان
Arz-e-Watan = ارضِ وطن
Jazba = جزبہ
Junoon = جنون
Muhabbat = محبت
Hosla = حوصلہ

Dimensions:  Length: 77-78 Inches | Width: 25-26 Inches

6926231273534.title: Arzoo Scarf - Shades Of Pink
6926231273534.description:
In life, have you ever met someone whose presence deeply connects with your heart? Every encounter leaves you yearning for more, and even when apart, their memories linger like sweet fragrances, inspiring heart-to-heart conversations.

Arzoo is an ode to Jaun Elia, who beautifully captures the emotions of love, longing, and mystery. His words paint a picture of a beautiful garden of emotions, where love's magic resides.

Material & Dimensions
Material: Crinkle Silk (100% Polyester)
 
Length: 68-70 Inches
Width: 26 Inches
 
Poetry
An Ode To Jaun Elia

،میں نے ہر بار تجھ سے ملتے وقت تجھ سے ملنے کی آرزو کی ہے
Each time we meet, I yearn for more,

،تیرے جانے کے بعد بھی میں نے تیری خوشبو سے گفتگو کی ہے
Even when apart, your fragrance I adore.

،یہ تیرے خط تری خوشبو یہ تیرے خواب و خیال، متاع جاں ہیں ترے
Your letters, dreams, and thoughts so dear,
Are treasures to me, their promises clear.

،قول اور قسم کی طرح گذشتہ سال انہیں میں نے گن کے رکھا تھا
کسی غریب کی جوڑی ہوئی رقم کی طرح ۔
Last year, I counted them, every one,
Like borrowed wealth, they shone like the sun.

،وہ کسی دن نہ آ سکے پر اسے پاس وعدے کو ہو نبھانے کا ہو
بسر انتظار میں ہر دن دوسرا دن ہو۔
One day, they may not come to be,
But I'll keep my word, just wait and see.

اس کے آنے کا ہے محبت حیات کی لذت ورنہ کچھ لذت حیات نہیں۔
Love brings joy to life, it's true,
Without it, life has no pleasure to pursue

کیا اجازت ہے ایک بات کہوں وہ مگر خیر کوئی بات نہیں۔
May I share a thought, though it may be small?
But really, it doesn't matter much at all

شرم دہشت جھجھک پریشانی ناز سے کام کیوں نہیں لیتیں۔
Your charm, your grace, so hard to resist,
Why not use them to your advantage, insist

آپ وہ جی مگر یہ سب کیا ہے تم مرا نام کیوں نہیں لیتیں۔
You have that magic, yet you don't speak my name,
Oh, the mystery behind this remains the same

پاس رہ کر جدائی کی تجھ سے دور ہو کر تجھے تلاش کیا۔
Close to you, I sought distance and space,
Far away, I searched for your sweet face

میں نے تیرا نشان گم کر کے اپنے اندر تجھے تلاش کیا۔
Lost your mark, yet within me, I sought,
For you, my dear, the love I have never forgot

جون ایلیا

7914167173182.description:
The Azal Cape is made using Acrylic Wool. Featuring a unisex wrap-around style, this cape has the words of Jigar Moradabadi on the borders. 

Material & Fit

About the Fit:

  • Unisex

  • Can be worn with any Eastern or Western Outfit depending on the Event.

*This Article is Free Size

Disclaimer:

  • The Kurta Pajama is Not Included in this article & Can be purchased separately.

Design Philosophy

It happens slowly. You start saying yes to things you don’t mean. Wearing what feels acceptable, and not what feels like you.

And then one day you look around and realize you’ve been molded.

That’s when it hits you. You were never meant to fit into this world, you were meant to stand out.

Azal Cape is a reminder to remember who you were before the world told you who to be.

To choose what feels right, wear what feels true, and become someone who feels like you.

Poetry

An Ode To Jigar Moradabadi

ہم کو مٹا سکے یہ زمانہ میں دم نہیں
Hum ko mita sakay ye zamana mein dam nahi,

ہم سے زمانہ خود ہے زمانے سے ہم نہیں
Hum se zamana khud hai, zamane se hum nahi.

Translation:

This world does not have the power to erase us,
The world exists because of us, we don’t exist because of it.

Care Instructions

Great Products Need Great Care!

  • Machine Washing Max. 30 C

Design Philosophy

Some feelings are so deeply rooted that they live beyond words. They settle into everything around us, into the leaves, the flowers, the air itself. Even when one bloom remains unaware, the entire garden knows the story of what has been felt and endured.

Bagh e Ulfat Cape is inspired by that quiet knowing. It reflects a love so present that it becomes part of its surroundings. A reminder that some emotions do not need to be spoken to be understood. They are felt, carried, and remembered by everything they touch.

Poetry

 

An Ode To Mir Taqi Mir

پتا پتا بوٹا بوٹا حال ہمارا جانے ہے
Pattā pattā, boota boota haal hamaara jaane hai

جانے نہ جانے گل ہی نہ جانے باغ تو سارا جانے ہے
Jaane na jaane gul hi na jaane, baagh to saara jaane hai

Translation:

Every leaf, every shrub knows the state of my heart
Whether the flower knows or not, the entire garden knows

7900462809150.description:
The world we live in is constantly evolving, making it easy to lose sight of our true purpose in life amidst all the distractions and noise. But it's up to us to shape it into something truly remarkable. Don't sit back and wait for someone else to take the first step. Embrace your unique vision and be the guiding light that inspires others to follow.

Karvaan Stole is an ode to Allama Iqbal which reminds us that with our creativity and passion, there's no limit to the incredible things we can achieve. So go forth and create a better world, one that is full of hope, love, and endless possibilities.

 An Ode To Allama Iqbal

نہ تو زمیں کے لیے ہے نہ آسماں کے لیے
جہاں ہے تیرے لیے تو نہیں جہاں کے لیے
You are neither for earth nor for heaven's light,
The world is yours, not you for its sight.
یہ عقل و دل ہیں شرر شعلۂ محبت کے
وہ خار و خس کے لیے ہے یہ نیستاں کے لیے
Reason and heart, sparks of love's flame,
One burns straw, one field of reed's shame.
مقام پرورش آہ و نالہ ہے یہ چمن
نہ سیر گل کے لیے ہے نہ آشیاں کے لیے
This garden is for mournful strains,
No place for nests or rose petal gains.
رہے گا راوی و نیل و فرات میں کب تک
ترا سفینہ کہ ہے بحر بیکراں کے لیے
How long shall your ship float in the Ravi, Nile, and Euphrates flow?
When the Ocean calls, there are no boundaries to know.
نشان راہ دکھاتے تھے جو ستاروں کو
ترس گئے ہیں کسی مرد راہ داں کے لیے
Once guides to stars, now lost in the dark,
Seeking a leader to leave their mark.
نگہ بلند سخن دل نواز جاں پرسوز
یہی ہے رخت سفر میر کارواں کے لیے
Ambition, speech, and soul aflame,
These are the only tools for a leader's game.
ذرا سی بات تھی اندیشۂ عجم نے اسے
بڑھا دیا ہے فقط زیب داستاں کے لیے
A simple truth, the Persian mind did find,
Transformed with imagination, a poetic bind.

7848944631870.description:
Chiragh Cape is made using Acrylic Wool. Featuring a unisex wrap-around style, this cape has the words of Kaif Moradaabadi calligraphed on the borders.

Material & Fit

*This Article is Free Size

Design Philosophy

At the end of the day, no one else is going to live your life for you. People can support you, sure, but the hard choices, the late nights, the battles, they’re yours to face. And that’s not a bad thing. Because these struggles, they shape you. They teach you strength and patience in ways nothing else can.

And once you’ve made it through, you have a chance to turn all of that into something more. To share your story, to help someone who’s still stuck where you once were, to be the chiragh you once wished you had.

Chiragh Cape is a reminder that maybe that’s the point of it all. Not just to survive our own darkness, but to leave behind enough light so that someone else finds their way a little easier. 

Poetry

An Ode To Kaif Moradaabadi 

بقا کی فکر کرو خود ہی زندگی کے لئے
(Baqa ki fikar karo khud hi zindagi ke liye)

زمانہ کچھ نہیں کرتا کبھی کسی کے لئے
(Zamana kuch nahi karta kabhi kisi ke liye)

کمال جب ہے کہ اس راہ میں چراغ جلاؤ
(Kamaal jab hai ke is raah mein chiraagh jalao)

جو مدتوں سے ترستی ہے روشنی کے لئے
(Jo mudaton se tarasti hai roshni ke liye)

Translation:

Worry about survival for the sake of your own life,
For the world never does anything for anyone.
The true greatness lies in lighting a lamp on that path,
Which has long been yearning for light.

6927446114366.title: Dastaan Scarf
6927446114366.description:
We all have someone we care about, a presence that makes us feel warm, but with life comes tragedy and expectations set loose. However, no matter what happens in the end, we always have the impact they made on our lives.

Dastaan pays homage to all those who have been a part of each of our journeys through life while reminding ourselves of the good that some experiences have come with, and their never-ending hope to teach us to enable ourselves to give back to the causes we love.

An Ode To Mirza Ghalib



Material: Crinkle Silk (100% Polyester)
Width: 26 Inches  | Length: 68-70 Inches

Poetry

An Ode To Mirza Ghalib

آہ کو چاہیے اک عمر اثر ہوتے تک
کون جیتا ہے تری زلف کے سر ہوتے تک

Yearning lasts a lifetime, like an age-old song,
Who wins life's battles till hair grows long?

دام ہر موج میں ہے حلقۂ صد کام نہنگ
دیکھیں کیا گزرے ہے قطرے پہ گہر ہوتے تک

In every wave, a world of tasks resides,
See what unfolds as drops take deep dives.

عاشقی صبر طلب اور تمنا بیتاب
دل کا کیا رنگ کروں خون جگر ہوتے تک

Love craves patience and dreams are restless,
How to paint the heart's canvas, till blood gets zealous?

تا قیامت شب فرقت میں گزر جائے گی عمر
سات دن ہم پہ بھی بھاری ہیں سحر ہوتے تک

Until eternity, nights of parting drift by,
Seven days weigh, even crowning the sky.

ہم نے مانا کہ تغافل نہ کرو گے لیکن
خاک ہو جائیں گے ہم تم کو خبر ہوتے تک

We vowed no neglect, but mark my word,
We'll turn to dust when our tale is heard.

پرتو خور سے ہے شبنم کو فنا کی تعلیم
میں بھی ہوں ایک عنایت کی نظر ہوتے تک

Dew learns from sunlight, fading in its grace,
I'm here too, seeking a special embrace.

یک نظر بیش نہیں فرصت ہستی غافل
گرمیٔ بزم ہے اک رقص شرر ہوتے تک

A single look can hold a world so vast,
Life isn't endless, it's moments that last.

غم ہستی کا اسدؔ کس سے ہو جز مرگ علاج
شمع ہر رنگ میں جلتی ہے سحر ہوتے تک

Asad, for life's pain, death's the cure we find,
The candle burns every hue, till dawn unwinds.

Design Philosophy

Everyone talks about how beautiful pearls are. But hardly anyone thinks about what they go through to become one.
It’s easy to just admire their shine and appreciate how delicate they seem. 

But if you ever try breaking one, you’ll realize that you can’t. A pearl is born from a wound. 

When something rough enters the shell, and instead of rejecting it, the oyster begins to protect itself. Layer by layer, it covers that pain until it turns it into something beautiful.

Dur-e-fishan Shawl is a reminder that people are kind of the same. They go through things that change them. It’s never easy, but every time they heal, they become quieter, softer even, but stronger in ways the world can’t always see.

Poetry

An Ode To Jigar Moradabadi

جو طوفانوں میں پلتے جا رہے ہیں
Jo toofanon mein palte ja rahe hain

وہی دنیا بدلتے جا رہے ہیں
Wohi duniya badalte ja rahe hain

نکھرتا آ رہا ہے رنگ گلشن
Nikharta aa raha hai rang-e-gulshan

خس و خاشاک جلتے جا رہے ہیں
Khas-o-khaashak jalte ja rahe hain

وہیں میں خاک اڑتی دیکھتا ہوں
Wahin main khaak udti dekhta hoon

جہاں چشمے ابلتے جا رہے ہیں
Jahan chashme ubalte ja rahe hain

Translation:

Those who are nurtured amidst storms
They are the ones changing the world.
The colors of the garden are growing brighter,
As the weeds and dry leaves burn away.
I see dust rising from the same place 
Where new springs are beginning to flow.

Design Philosophy

Kuch hasratain aisi hoti hain jo zindagi bhar dil se nahi jaati, chahe waqt kitna bhi guzar jaye.

The moments and people we wish we could hold onto forever. But time doesn’t give back what’s gone. That’s the hard part, realising no amount of wishing can bring the past back.

But that doesn’t mean those things are lost completely. They live on in us. In the way a song can suddenly remind me of so many memories. In the way a scent carries you back years in an instant. In the way stories keep people and moments alive long after they’re gone.

Hasrat Cape is a reminder that maybe we don’t overcome longing. Maybe we just learn to walk with it, letting it remind us of what mattered, and to honour it as part of our story.

Poetry

 

An Ode To Sahir Ludhianvi

نہ تو زمیں کے لئے ہے نہ آسماں کے لیے
(Na to zameen ke liye hai, na aasmaan ke liye)

ترا وجود ہے اب صرف داستاں کے لیے
(Tera wujood hai ab sirf daastan ke liye)

پلٹ کے سوئے چمن دیکھنے سے کیا ہوگا
(Palat ke soye chaman dekhne se kya hoga)

وہ شاخ ہی نہ رہی جو تھی آشیاں کے لیے
(Woh shaakh hi na rahi jo thi aashiyan ke liye)

Translation:

Neither for the earth, nor for the sky you exist,
Your existence now is only for a tale to persist.
What’s the use of turning back to see the garden again,
The branch that was your nest no longer remains.

Today when you stand in front of a mirror and glance into it- what do you see? The person in front of you only captures an image of yourself for a millisecond but you are so much more.

You are the essence of countless experiences that have shaped you into who you have become today - from the tears to the laughter, days of loneliness, and moments where your heart felt full. And the unimaginable twists and turns life has yet to bring your way.

Aaina is an ode to you and the immeasurable beauty you possess that remains hidden within you.

An Ode To Jaun Elia

تم حقیقت نہیں ہو حسرت ہو
You're my longing, not quite real,

جو ملے خواب میں وہ دولت ہو 
You're a dream's treasure, and my heart's ideal.

کس لئے دیکھتی ہو آئینہ
Why seek mirrors for grace?

تم تو خود سے بھی خوبصورت ہو 
Your beauty shines with effortless grace.

داستاں ختم ہونے والی ہے
The story's end is drawing near,

تم مری آخری محبت ہو
You're my last love, so precious and dear.

I revealed a secret in the crowded space,

بڑا بے ادب ہوں سزا چاہتا ہوں

7280950444094.title: Jugnu Kurta - Royal Green
7280950444094.description:
You are kind, You are thoughtful, You are the Jugnu.

This world is so self-centered that your kindness feels like a breath of fresh air. You’re the person who brings a bit of sunshine when everything seems cloudy and dark. 

Jugnu Kurta is a Thank You for being a source of positivity in a sometimes dim world. And for making someone's day a little better. Because in the end, it's the simple acts of kindness that make the world a brighter place for all of us.

Poetry 
 An Ode to Allama Iqbal


ٹہنی پہ کسی شجر کی تنہا 
بلبل تھا کوئی اداس بیٹھا 
On a branch, a tree all alone,
A sad bird, just sitting on its own.

کہتا تھا کہ رات سر پہ آئی 
اڑنے چگنے میں دن گزارا 
Talking 'bout the night, quiet and still,
Flying and singing, time to fulfill.

پہنچوں کس طرح آشیاں تک 
ہر چیز پہ چھا گیا اندھیرا 
How do I get to the cozy nest?
Darkness everywhere, a tough quest.

سن کر بلبل کی آہ و زاری 
جگنو کوئی پاس ہی سے بولا 
حاضر ہوں مدد کو جان و دل سے 
کیڑا ہوں اگرچہ میں ذرا سا 

Nightingale's sadness, a firefly replied,
"I'm small but ready to be your guide."

کیا غم ہے جو رات ہے اندھیری 
میں راہ میں روشنی کروں گا 
"What's the sorrow in the night so deep?
I'll light up the path, no need to weep."

ہیں لوگ وہی جہاں میں اچھے 
آتے ہیں جو کام دوسروں کے 
"What's the sorrow in the night so deep?
I'll light up the path, no need to weep."

Material & Fit

Material:  Jacquard (100% Polyester)

About The Fit:

  • Long Length Straight Kurta
  • V-Shaped Neck
  • Straight Loose Fit Full Sleeves 
  • Printed Border On The Sleeves and Bottom Hem
  • Available In 3 Colours

  • MACHINE WASHING MAX 30C
  • DO NOT BLEACH
  • IRONING MAX 110C
  • DRY CLEANING PERCHLOROETHYLENE
  • DO NOT TUMBLE DRY

7974262833214.title: Junoon Stole - Midnight Blue
7974262833214.description:
Junoon is the intensity and passion experienced in love, like a tempest that consumes everything in its path. But love is also a choice to stand by someone through thick and thin, a judgment made with the heart and mind, and a promise to love and support each other.

Junoon Stole pays tribute to Shaukat Wasti and reminds us to let love be the foundation upon which we build our lives, brick by brick, storm by storm.

Poetry

 An Ode To Shaukat Wasti

جنوں سکون خرد اضطراب چاہتی ہے
طبیعت آج نیا انقلاب چاہتی ہے

Passion, tranquility, reason, unrest desire,
Today nature seeks a new revolution's fire.

نہ آج تیری نظر سے برس رہا ہے نشہ
نہ میری تشنہ لبی ہی شراب چاہتی ہے

Neither from your gaze is pouring intoxication's rain,
Nor my thirsty lips desire any wine's refrain.

نہیں سرور مسلسل نباہ پر موقوف
مدام آنکھ کہاں لطف خواب چاہتی ہے

Not continuously in joy or sorrow's arrest,
My eyes forever search for the pleasures of sleep and rest.

سنا رہا ہوں فسانہ تری محبت کا
یہ کائنات عمل کا حساب چاہتی ہے

I hear the tale of your love's enchanting spell,
As the universe seeks a balanced tale to tell.

جھلس رہا ہے بدن دھوپ میں جوانی کی
یہ آگ زلف کا گہرا سحاب چاہتی ہے

In the sun's heat, youth's vigor still strives to stay,
As the depth of your tresses seeks the cloud's spray.

حریف حسن و محبت ہو دیر تک شوکتؔ
نگار عمر وہ عہد شباب چاہتی ہے

O, Shaukat, may love's rival and passion last long,
As the beauty of youth longs for the era of the youthful song.

Material & Dimensions

Material: Double Sided, 100% Textured Polyester
Dimensions: Length 79-80 Inches, Width 19-20 Inches

Care Instructions
  • Dry Clean Only 
  • Hand Wash Cold
  • Line Dry in Shade

7974263783486.title: Junoon Stole - Rosewood
7974263783486.description:
Junoon is the intensity and passion experienced in love, like a tempest that consumes everything in its path. But love is also a choice to stand by someone through thick and thin, a judgment made with the heart and mind, and a promise to love and support each other.

Junoon Stole pays tribute to Shaukat Wasti and reminds us to let love be the foundation upon which we build our lives, brick by brick, storm by storm.

Poetry

 An Ode To Shaukat Wasti

جنوں سکون خرد اضطراب چاہتی ہے
طبیعت آج نیا انقلاب چاہتی ہے

Passion, tranquility, reason, unrest desire,
Today nature seeks a new revolution's fire.

نہ آج تیری نظر سے برس رہا ہے نشہ
نہ میری تشنہ لبی ہی شراب چاہتی ہے

Neither from your gaze is pouring intoxication's rain,
Nor my thirsty lips desire any wine's refrain.

نہیں سرور مسلسل نباہ پر موقوف
مدام آنکھ کہاں لطف خواب چاہتی ہے

Not continuously in joy or sorrow's arrest,
My eyes forever search for the pleasures of sleep and rest.

سنا رہا ہوں فسانہ تری محبت کا
یہ کائنات عمل کا حساب چاہتی ہے

I hear the tale of your love's enchanting spell,
As the universe seeks a balanced tale to tell.

جھلس رہا ہے بدن دھوپ میں جوانی کی
یہ آگ زلف کا گہرا سحاب چاہتی ہے

In the sun's heat, youth's vigor still strives to stay,
As the depth of your tresses seeks the cloud's spray.

حریف حسن و محبت ہو دیر تک شوکتؔ
نگار عمر وہ عہد شباب چاہتی ہے

O, Shaukat, may love's rival and passion last long,
As the beauty of youth longs for the era of the youthful song.

7745180172350.title: Lehr
7745180172350.description:
Sharp, fresh, and a little crisp. It opens with a rush of sea air, cool, salty and refreshing, laced with just a hint of ginger’s quiet heat, like the sun warming your skin. Then comes the depth, seaweed and vetiver, raw and earthy, the scent of waves crashing against the shore. And finally, the grounding warmth of cedarwood and oakmoss, smooth and steady, like driftwood carried by the tide.

Key Notes & Ingredients:

Concentration: 20%

Size: 80ml

Scent Profile: Masculine

Top Notes: Sea Salt, Ginger
Middle Notes: Seaweed, Vetiver
Base Notes: Cedarwood, Oakmoss

Ideal for: Free spirits, travelers, lovers of coastal freshness.

7745182695486.title: Leila
7745182695486.description:
Fresh, soft, and just a little addictive. This scent opens with the juicy sweetness of litchi and pear, balanced by a bright hint of bergamot and a subtle kick of pink pepper. Then, the soft florals take over, Turkish rose and peony delicate yet full of life, bringing a light, airy freshness. And as it settles, the warmth kicks in, white musk, woody notes, and Haitian vetiver, skin, comforting and familiar.

Key Notes & Ingredients:

Concentration: 20%

Size: 100ml

Scent Profile: Feminine

Top Notes: Litchi, Pear, Bergamot, Pink Pepper
Middle Notes: Turkish Rose, Peony, Watery Notes, Floral Notes
Base Notes: White Musk, Woody Notes, Haitian Vetiver

Ideal for: Romantic souls, dreamers, those who love floral (Turkish Rose) and rich musky profiles.

Design Philosophy

You notice something from far away and immediately assume it’s something interesting… something big.
Then you walk closer and realise it’s actually nothing special at all.

And instead of feeling silly, you just smile at yourself.
Because it makes you realise how ready you are to believe that life is still full of surprises. And honestly, there’s something nice about that. 

Mashal Stole is a reminder that a part of you still expects good things. Still looks for meaning, and still wants to find something special in everyday moments. And in a world where everything feels predictable, that tiny hope to expect “something more” is what makes you feel a little more alive.

Poetry

An Ode To Allama Iqbal

جگنو کی روشنی ہے کاشانۂ چمن میں
Jugnu ki roshni hai kashan-e-chaman mein

یا شمع جل رہی ہے پھولوں کی انجمن میں
Ya shama jal rahi hai phoolon ki anjuman mein

Translation:

Is it the glow of a firefly lighting the garden’s abode,
Or a candle burning softly in the gathering of flowers?

  • Do Not Bleach
  • Ironing Max 110 C
  • Dry Cleaning Perchloroethylene
  • Do Not Tumble Dry

Design Philosophy 

Life is a journey, where you and I are two musafirs traveling side by side. And on this journey, we'll face many challenges together. But the best part is how we'll support one another.

Kabhi mai compromise karun, kabhi tum. And it's these moments where both are willing to adjust and meet halfway, that'll make this safar easier and more enjoyable.

Musafir Kurta is a reminder that to walk side by side on this journey, you and I need to be ready to listen and understand each other. By staying on the same page, we can turn all the tough times into shared adventures, making every hurdle a stepping stone.gentle reminder that some of the best things in life take their time, and that’s okay.

Poetry 
An Ode to Nida Fazli

ممکن ہے سفر ہو آساں اب ساتھ بھی چل کر دیکھیں
(Mumkin hai safar ho aasan, ab saath bhi chal kar dekhein)

کچھ تم بھی بدل کر دیکھو کچھ ہم بھی بدل کر دیکھیں
Kuch tum bhi badal kar dekho, kuch hum bhi badal kar dekhein)

Translation:
Perhaps the journey will be easier if we walk together now.
Change a little yourself and let us change a little too.

An Ode to Sahir Ludhianvi

ہزار برق گرے لاکھ آندھیاں اٹھیں
Hazaar barq giray, laakh aandhiyaan uthain

وہ پھول کھل کے رہیں گے جو کھلنے والے ہیں
Woh phool khil ke rahenge jo khilne waale hain

Translation:

A thousand lightning bolts may fall, a million storms may rise
Yet the flowers destined to bloom will surely bloom

Design Philosophy

Destiny isn’t always about what we want. Sometimes, it’s about what we need. 

We often spend our time chasing goals and dreams, thinking they’ll bring us happiness, but true joy comes from the unexpected.

Sure, you’ll come across multiple challenges. But these struggles, the setbacks, they’re not obstacles, they’re shaping you, guiding you towards what’s meant for you.
After all, what we truly need often finds its way to us when we least expect it. 

Musarrat Shawl is a reminder that true joy isn’t necessarily always found in the path that you wanted, but the one that’s right for you. Because when the time comes, the right things will always find a way to grow.

جو اعلی ظرف ہوتے ہیں ہمیشہ جھک کے ملتے ہیں

Those who are noble always meet with humility,
A decanter bows down to fill the cup.

Design Philosophy

It’s strange, isn’t it?
You give something your all, your time, your effort, your creativity. But once it’s out there, it doesn’t really belong to you any more.

The stories you write, the memories you create, they all carry a piece of who you are. And still, you don’t get to decide how they’re remembered.

People rewrite, reinterpret, and rearrange them. As if the hands that made them never existed. But even then, you keep creating. You keep giving.

Nazm Stole is a reminder that maybe it was never about owning what you create. Maybe what actually matters is knowing it meant something to someone, somewhere.

Poetry

An Ode To Sahir Ludhianvi

ہمیں سے رنگِ گلستاں، ہمیں سے رنگِ بہار
Humein se rang-e-gulistaan, humein se rang-e-bahaar

ہمیں کو نظمِ گلستاں پہ اختیار نہیں
Humein ko nazm-e-gulistaan pe ikhtiyaar nahin

Translation:

It is from us that the garden gets its color, and from us that spring gains its beauty,
Yet we have no control over how the garden is arranged.

Design Philosophy

They say a parwana doesn’t think before it flies into the flame. It knows the fire will burn and still, it goes closer. That it’s foolish, doomed, a creature of obsession.

But aren’t we all like that? Drawn to something we know could hurt us, and still choosing to go closer.
A person, a dream, a moment, it doesn’t matter. What matters is how alive it made us feel.

Truth is, the parwana doesn’t chase light because it’s blind. It chases it because, in that glow, it sees itself alive, certain, free.

The Parwana Weaved Shawl is a reminder that maybe that’s what we’re all searching for too. That one feeling that makes everything else fade away for a moment. Yes, it burns. Yes, it ends. But at that moment it also gives us the courage to love fully, live wildly, and to be free.

م، ن، ٹ,، و

7745183776830.description:
Woody, effortless, and just a little unforgettable. It opens with a cool, crisp breath of water and cypress, clean, airy, like stepping outside after the rain. Then, a quiet warmth sneaks in, cedarwood, patchouli, and sandalwood, deep and grounding, like the feeling of running your fingers over old, polished wood. And just when you think you’ve figured it out, soft white flowers bloom in the background, delicate but undeniable, adding a touch of quiet elegance.

Key Notes & Ingredients:

Concentration: 20%

Size: 100ml

Scent Profile: Masculine

Top Notes: Aqueous, Aromatic, Cypress
Middle Notes: Cedarwood, Patchouli, Sandalwood, White Flower
Base Notes: Aqueous, Aromatic, Cypress

Ideal for: Deep thinkers, artists, and anyone drawn to mystery and masculine warmth and woody profiles.

8004548493374.description:
In a world where everyone’s eyes are on us, our eyes are locked on one another. You and me - our story is one that stirs a sense of Rashk within those who are watching us. Truthfully, all that I can see is your beauty, for you radiate such a glow that even the moon feels envious as it pales in comparison to you.

Rashk Shawl is an ode to your love story. It’s a reminder that the world feels envious when it sees you and your love bloom. For you nothing else matters except for the hand you’re holding, the voice you’re hearing, and the smile you’re seeing.  

Poetry 

 An Ode to Daagh Dehelvi

,سب لوگ جدھر وہ ہیں ادھر دیکھ رہے ہیں
Where others look, we gaze,

,ہم دیکھنے والوں کی نظر دیکھ رہے ہیں
Seeing through the eyes of those amazed.
,تیور ترے اے رشک قمر دیکھ رہے ہیں
Oh, envy-worthy moon, they're watching you,
,ہم شام سے آثار سحر دیکھ رہے ہیں
While we behold the morning's magical hue.
,اب تک تو جو قسمت نے دکھایا وہی دیکھا
What fate revealed till now we've seen,
-آئندہ ہو کیا نفع و ضرر دیکھ رہے ہیں
The future's gains and losses, yet unseen.

Design Philosophy

Mehfils… they’ve never really been about the music, the chai, or the mithai. They’re about the people who bring them to life. The cousins you laugh with until your stomach hurts. The aunties who pile food on your plate, no matter how much you protest, the friends who somehow turn an ordinary evening into a story you’ll tell for years.

Our mehfils are loud, colourful, gloriously messy. A little chaotic, yes, but always filled with love. Because in the end, it’s about being together with the people you love. 

It’s about joy that doubles when it’s shared. The love that feels louder in a room full of laughter, and those bonds jo ek mamuli si mehfil ko bhi aur khaas bana dete hain.

Words Mentioned

گلاب — Gulaab
خوشبو — Khushboo
کلی — Kali
گل پوش — Gulposh
گل — Gul
غنچہ — Ghuncha

Care Instructions

To ensure that it remains as beautiful as the day you first wore it:

  • Dry Clean Only: To preserve the beauty and integrity of your garment and handwork, please have it dry cleaned. This will ensure the fabric and delicate details remain in perfect condition for years to come.

  • No Tumble Drying: The gentle nature of silk and handwork doesn't fare well with the rough tumble of a dryer. Instead, after cleaning, lay the garment flat on a clean towel to air dry in the shade. This will help preserve its softness and keep the embroidery intact.

  • Avoid perfumes on Handwork: Avoid spraying perfume or deodorants directly onto the Handwork, as these may cause discoloration or damage to the embroidery.

  • Iron with Care: Should you need to iron, turn the garment inside out and use a low-heat setting. For the Handwork area, place a cloth between the iron and the fabric to protect the delicate hand embroidery from direct heat.

  • Storing Your Garment: When you’re not wearing it, fold it gently with tissue paper over handwork and place it on a flat surface.

  • Guard Against Humidity and Light: Store your garment in a place free of humidity and direct sunlight, so it can continue to bring joy for years to come.

  •  A Final Thought: This garment is more than just fabric—it's a piece of artistry. Treat it with the love and care it deserves, and it will reward you by maintaining its elegance through many occasions to come.

Design Philosophy

The women in your life have this way of doing everything, but making it look like nothing. The ones who carry five things, fix two problems, and still ask if you’ve eaten.

For them, it’s not multitasking, rather, it’s just a casual Tuesday. By the time you realise something’s wrong, they’ve already solved it. They notice just about everything. And somehow still have the energy to care.

Saaz Shawl is an ode to the women in your life. They’re the ones keeping the whole thing running. And somehow, they always make it all look easy.

Poetry

An Ode To Allama Iqbal

وجودِ زن سے ہے تصویرِ کائنات میں رنگ
Wujood-e-zan se hai tasveer-e-kainaat mein rang

اسی کے ساز سے ہے زندگی کا سوزِ دروں
Usi ke saaz se hai zindagi ka soz-e-daroon

Translation:

It is the existence of woman that lends color to the picture of the universe.
It is from her melody that life draws its inner passion.

Design Philosophy

Let’s be honest, some days are just hard.

Things don’t go your way. People disappoint you. The plan you were counting on falls apart. 

And you want to pause. Maybe even quit. Because, facing challenge after challenge, it’s exhausting.

But here’s the truth… It’s supposed to be hard because that’s how you learn who you are. 

Sang-e-Raah Shawl is a reminder that every time you face something that could’ve broken you, still showing up the next day, that’s growth. 

And maybe that’s what matters. Not that you never fall, not that you never doubt yourself, but that you keep getting back up anyway. Because no one ever really feels ready, we just keep walking. Especially when it feels hard.

Poetry

An Ode to Nida Fazli

سفر میں دھوپ تو ہوگی جو چل سکو تو چلو

Sabhi hain bheer mein, tum bhi nikal sako to chalo

Translation:

There will be sunlight on the journey — walk on if you can.
Everyone is lost in the crowd — step forward if you can.

Poetry

An Ode to Makhdoom Mohiuddin

(Phir chhiri raat baat phoolon ki)

رات ہے یا برات پھولوں کی

Translation:
Once again, the night begins to speak in flowers.

Design Philosophy

There are those moments when everything feels perfect, when you're lost in joy, fully immersed in the present. But then, in an instant, something from the past returns. A memory, a thought, a feeling. Just for a second, a soft, sad smile appears, not from sorrow, but from the quiet realization that this beautiful moment feels strangely familiar, as if it’s tied to something else, something lost, something once cherished.

We don’t even have a name for this feeling. It’s something we don’t often talk about, but the beautiful thing is, when we notice someone going through it, we simply stand by them, quietly letting them know they’re not alone.

Shaposh Scarf is the reminder of that fleeting, bittersweet beauty. It’s not just about the flowers or the night; it’s about how joy and sadness can coexist.

پھر چھڑی رات بات پھولوں کی

In that instant, we remember that life is a blend of moments, joy, sorrow, and everything in between.

7265465172030.description:
Once upon a time, Shah Jahan and Mumtaz Mahal wrote a story of love that even death couldn't erase. It was the pain that Shah Jahan felt after his beloved passed that he decided he would preserve the reflection of his love forever. 

And so, the Taj Mahal, a love story written in marble, was born from the depths of a broken heart. But it was more than the domes and the minarets, it was a symbol of their undying love. Each block of marble spoke of their shared moments – the stolen glances, the whispered promises, and the laughter that echoed through the palace halls. And soon the world watched as the Taj Mahal emerged as a tribute to the woman who had captured Shah Jahan’s soul.

Wherever you wander, love's wild heart will find its way,

An Ode To شکیل بدایونی

Wrapped in its hold, a thought takes wing,
Life is a tale where love is the song we sing.

The Zeest Kurta, Made from Premium Lawn, Features Urdu Calligraphy of Poetry by Nida Fazli. The Straight Long Length Kurta is Available in 3 Colors!

Material & Fit

About The Fit:

  • Long Length Kurta
  • Full Sleeves with Cuff & Button
  • Boat Neckline with Button and Detailed Stitching on the Placket
  • Rounded Hemline and Both Sides are Finished with a Border
  • The model is wearing a size "Small."
Disclaimer:
Please note that the actual product color may vary from the pictures due to lighting differences. While we aim for accuracy, variations may occur.
Design Philosophy

Kaam toh kabhi khatam hi nahi hotay. 

I know life has started to feel like an endless marathon, with every turn bringing in new challenges. All these worries leave you tired and overwhelmed, and you wish for a moment to just breathe and hit pause… I know. I've been there. 


But in these moments, know that even the fastest animal, the cheetah, takes short breaks to maintain its fast pace. And so can you!  Taking a break isn't a sign of weakness, rather, it’s what prepares you to face all these challenges.

The Zeest Kurta reminds you, that much like the cheetah makes time to catch its breath, you too can slow down and rest. Because through these breaks, you will come back stronger, ready to sprint again. 

Poetry

 An Ode To Nida Fazli

دریا ہو یا پہاڑ ہو ٹکرانا چاہئے
جب تک نہ سانس ٹوٹے جیے جانا چاہئے

Whether against the sea or a mighty hill,
Keep pushing till your breath stands still.
